cover.prompt: A dramatic digital illustration of a world map with three glowing hotspots: East Asia (Japan and Taiwan), the Middle East (Strait of Hormuz), and Eastern Europe (Kursk region). Red arrows and military silhouettes converge on these points, with a dark stormy sky background. No text, no real faces, no flags. Style: geopolitical news illustration, cinematic lighting, high contrast.
